purpose: Regression scenarios for default-preload / zero-keyword activation, 100%-per-user-turn visible status, Question Scan (Q1/Q2/Q3), mandatory four-field closing status reports, explicit disable/restore, understanding gate, latest-wins behavior, and final delivery checks. Repository tests can validate the policy contract; true always-on activation still requires a host that preloads No-Rush before routing.
